what: Demo runs timed after the demo speedups, the way the worker times a run (demo_site/worker.py, RUN_TIMES): from its upload to its end, less the time it waited for its person's answers, by the kind of file it read (chip or whole_genome). The page's estimate for each kind counts these beside the runs the demo times itself, until five of that kind are timed there. No whole genome is here: the one timed on 10-15 (113.6 minutes) imputed the whole genome, so whole genomes are timed afresh by the demo itself.
